say:6:1720817005:0.text: Tell me why that ridiculous ban is still hanging over my head.
say:6:1720817005:0.source_cn: 先别说这个。我说，不让我来这里玩牌的规矩怎么还没改？

say:7:1720817006:0.text: Five years, Eryndor. Five years! Isn't that long enough for something this petty?
say:7:1720817006:0.source_cn: 五年，都已经整整五年了！也该把这种无关紧要的规矩废除了吧？

say:8:1720817007:0.source_cn: 这可有些为难我了。谁让你的牌技实在太令人侧目了呢？

say:9:1720817008:1.text: While loss may be a charming lesson in moderation, I find little appeal in wagering my establishment against your inclinations.
